name: Felt & Timber
detail: Play softly; A: intimate felt grand — hammers close, strings bloom behind. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Stage Cedar
detail: Dig in; A: bright stage grand, B: octave shimmer an octave up. Slap delay on the tail. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Tape Parlor
detail: Worn cassette upright — gentle crush plus a slow wow wobble. Play late-night chords. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Honky Tonk Union
detail: Detuned barroom upright, slightly drunk and proud of it. Single notes honk, chords grin. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Clavi Snapper
detail: Bitey clav with an envelope-follower wah — dig in and it quacks. Ghost-note friendly. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Harpsi Double
detail: Quilled harpsichord with an octave double — baroque lines, short slapback. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Mello Flute Keys
detail: Breathy flute-keys for slow melodies — long phrases, lots of air. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Dulci Wire
detail: Hammered dulcimer with a breath of shimmer — fast runs sparkle. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Sunday Pipes
detail: Full chapel pipes under a cathedral ceiling. Hold big chords and listen upward. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Gospel Shout
detail: Shouting combo organ through a spinning rotary — fast Leslie, play rhythmic stabs. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Chapel Dust
detail: Dusty chapel organ dissolving into shimmer — sparse hymn fragments. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Nylon Courtyard
detail: Warm nylon fingerpicking in a small courtyard. Thumb bass, singing treble. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Glass Twelve
detail: Twelve-string shimmer — octave courses ringing through chorus and air. Strum wide open. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Ebow Prayer
detail: Infinite-bow guitar note that never wants to land — slow phaser sweep carries it. One note is enough. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Sub Marine
detail: Clean deep-sea sub — mono, round, felt more than heard. Leave room below it. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Acid Garden
detail: Resonant acid line with glide — write it a semitone too low, slide home. Ping-pong repeats. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Fretless Rain
detail: Singing fretless that slides between every note — mwah for days. Legato lines only. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Compactor
detail: Punchy picked bass through a hard-working compressor — every note lands flat and loud. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Solo Thread
detail: One violin, close-miked and emotional. Slow bows, heavy vibrato. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Amber Section
detail: Full string section in warm unison — swells and sustains, no soloists. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Pizz Corner
detail: Dry pizzicato section, playful and precise. Short notes, quick rhythms. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Copper Shout
detail: Bright solo brass with attitude — short phrases, big accents. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Flugel Dusk
detail: Mellow flugelhorn at last light — soft attacks, long goodbyes. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Stab Alley
detail: Gritty brass stab with an octave underbelly and a dirty edge. Hit it and run. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Breath Flute
detail: Airy bamboo flute — as much breath as tone. Phrases that wander off. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Reed Confession
detail: Warm clarinet telling secrets — soft tonguing, round middle register. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Oboe Lantern
detail: Nasal double-reed glowing through a fixed vowel filter — ancient and reedy. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Neon Suture
detail: Supersaw mono lead stitched wide — glide into every note, let the ping-pong answer. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Mono Ribbon
detail: Singing mono ribbon — square-wave heart, endless glide, phaser swirling behind. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Glass Fang
detail: Metallic FM fang over a hard edge — glassy, vicious, with crushed sparkle. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Satin Laser
detail: Soft sci-fi laser lines — gentle glide, slow PWM breathing underneath. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Slow Honey
detail: Warm analog honey poured very slowly — hold one chord and disappear into it. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Choir Loft
detail: Distant choir in a stone loft — vowels drifting, no words. Sing with it. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Glass Drift
detail: Ice crystals drifting through cathedral shimmer — high, weightless, endless. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Black Moss
detail: Dark subterranean bed that breathes through a slow phaser — beautiful dread. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Gate Crasher
detail: Gated rhythmic comp — hold a chord, the gate does the funk. Tight and hype. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Sidechain Ghost
detail: Pumping dance comp that breathes around an invisible kick — four-on-the-floor required. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Neon Stab
detail: Bright digital stab-chords with chorus glitter — 80s rooftop at midnight. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Music Box Ghost
detail: A haunted music box two octaves up — tiny hammers, endless shimmer tail. Play sparse. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Marimba Smoke
detail: Warm wooden marimba bars in a smoky room — round attack, gentle room. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Steel Horizon
detail: Resonant steel bars on the horizon — bright strike, long metallic bloom. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Fog Horn Bay
detail: Harbor foghorn rolling over the water — lean on one low note and wait. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Laser Drawer
detail: One zap from the cutlery drawer of the future — short, rude, flanged. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Thunder Sheet
detail: Shaken thunder sheet over subterranean rumble in a canyon — distant at first, then everywhere. Strike once. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Arp Botanica
detail: A garden that arpeggiates itself — two-octave vines through shimmer and echo. Hold and wander. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Granular Pond
detail: Pebbles of glass audio dropped in a still pond — shimmer ripples, slow pan current. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Sweep Chapel
detail: Eight-second filter tide rolling through a chapel — one chord, endless motion. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Sitar Monsoon
detail: Buzzing sitar over its own drone string — ornaments and slides welcome. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Shakuhachi Mist
detail: Bamboo breath fading in and out of fog — start notes from silence. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Santur Spark
detail: Seventy-two strings struck with tiny hammers — rapid dulcimer runs ignite. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Tine Stage 76
detail: Play with touch; A: classic stage tine — bell attack, singing body, natural decay. Velocity opens the bite. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Suitcase Warmth
detail: Play soft chords; A: round suitcase piano — pillowy attack, warm endlessly-decaying body. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Glass Hammer
detail: Strike firmly; A: glassy hammer EP — bright percussive top over a deep body. Velocity brings the sparkle. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Midnight Felt
detail: Play at midnight; A: dark felted tine — muted, close, velvety, long slow decay into silence. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Bell Reed 200
detail: Play with touch; A: bell-forward reed piano — chime riding a warm reed body, decaying naturally. X: Color; Y: Ensemble.

name: Eighty-Three Tines -CL
detail: The 1983 FM electric piano: glassy tine on top, round body underneath, a slow shimmer between two detuned pairs. Soft touch stays mellow, hard touch barks. Play ballad chords with the pedal. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Ballad Glass -CL
detail: A rounder, softer FM piano for quiet verses: gentle tine, warm body, a wider chorus between the pairs and a long singing decay. Play it sparse and let notes ring. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Tine Bark -CL
detail: Funk and soul FM piano with teeth: touch decides everything, from a clean ping to a growling bark with a little grit. Comp sixteenths and dig in on the accents. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Bell Tine Nineties -CL
detail: The glossy 90s R&B ballad piano: a clear bell partial over a soft round body, shimmering and wide. Lush slow chords, pedal down. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Wurli Smoke -CL
detail: Reed piano in the Wurlitzer tradition: warm and nasal when you play softly, a growling bark when you dig in. Soul ballads, Supertramp-style riffs. The preset Tremolo is the classic vibrato switch. X: Bark; Y: Decay.

name: Pianet Spark -CL
detail: A short, woody reed pluck after the Hohner Pianet: bright tick, quick bloom, gone. Great for sixties pop comping and staccato hooks. X: Tone; Y: Decay.

name: Clav Stax -CL
detail: Funk clavinet with a darker, thicker bite than a bright wah clav: tight strings, fast mute on release. Play choppy sixteenths; the preset Auto-wah turns it into Superstition. X: Bite; Y: Decay.

name: Harmonium Porch -CL
detail: Pump harmonium: two reeds a hair apart, a little bellows breath and a gentle swell. Folk hymns, drones under a vocal, film scores. X: Reeds; Y: Bellows.

name: House Piano 90 -CL
detail: The bright, punchy early-90s house piano: a hollow FM body with a bell pair on top. Block chords on the offbeat, one note per finger, lots of velocity. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Electric Grand 80 -CL
detail: Electric grand in the CP-80 spirit: string twang up top, a slightly out-of-tune chorus between unisons, a strong midrange that cuts through a band. 80s ballads and new wave. X: Brightness; Y: Decay.

name: Lo-Fi Upright -CL
detail: A worn upright through an old tape machine: soft hammers, a little wow and flutter, crushed top end. Hip-hop chords, bedroom ballads. X: Tape; Y: Crush.

name: Drawbar Jazz -CL
detail: Jazz tonewheel organ: 16, 5 1/3 and 8 foot drawbars out, third-harmonic percussion and key click. Walk the bass with your left hand; the preset Tremolo is a rotary speaker. X: Drive; Y: Click.

name: Rock Drive -CL
detail: All drawbars out into an overdriven amp: the rock organ that growls on chords and screams on glissandos. The preset Tremolo is a fast rotary. X: Drive; Y: Click.

name: Combo Sixty -CL
detail: Transistor combo organ from the garage-band sixties: buzzy squares at 8 and 4 foot. Ninety-six Tears, ska upstrokes, surf. The preset Tremolo is its vibrato. X: Tone; Y: Octave.

name: Musette Café -CL
detail: Paris musette accordion: three reeds tuned apart for that shimmering wobble, a breath of bellows. Waltzes, tangos, café scenes. X: Musette; Y: Bellows.

name: Solina Glow -CL
detail: String machine glow: a buzzing ensemble of saws, thin at the bottom and shimmering on top, straight out of 70s disco and space rock. The preset Chorus deepens the ensemble. X: Ensemble; Y: Attack.

name: Cinema Section -CL
detail: A big, slow-swelling string section with the upper octave floating above it: film cues, worship swells, the last chorus. Hold chords and let them bloom. X: Swell; Y: Octave.

name: Staccato Bows -CL
detail: Short, bitey string section for rhythm: spiccato eighths, pop-string stabs, driving ostinatos. Velocity sets the bite. X: Length; Y: Bite.

name: Cello Lament -CL
detail: A solo cello line: legato slides, a woody body resonance and vibrato that blooms as the note holds. Channel pressure deepens the vibrato. Play one voice, slowly. X: Vibrato; Y: Bow.

name: Jump Brass -CL
detail: The bright synth-brass stab of 80s rock anthems: two detuned saws, a blatty filter bite on every chord. Big block chords on the beat. X: Brightness; Y: Blat.

name: Section Punch -CL
detail: A tight horn section for funk and soul hits: fast swell, short fall, all punch. Stab the offbeats. X: Punch; Y: Length.

name: Horn Swell -CL
detail: Warm French horns swelling in slowly: film pads, hymn endings, a soft bed under a ballad. Channel pressure opens them up. X: Swell; Y: Warmth.

name: Muted Noir -CL
detail: A harmon-muted trumpet for film noir and late-night jazz: nasal, breathy, with a vibrato that arrives late. Play single lines; pressure opens the mute. X: Mute; Y: Vibrato.

name: Sawtooth Sermon -CL
detail: The fat mono saw lead: two detuned saws over a sub, a squelch on every attack and legato glide. Solos that preach. Mod wheel adds vibrato and brightness. X: Cutoff; Y: Glide.

name: Sync Scream -CL
detail: Hard-sync lead that tears open on each note and settles into a singing tone. New wave solos, rock hooks. Pressure pushes the sync harder. X: Scream; Y: Sweep.

name: Whistle Portamento -CL
detail: A soft, pure whistle of a lead with slow glide and a vibrato that blooms: ballad melodies, Morricone lines, a voice-like counter-melody. X: Glide; Y: Vibrato.

name: Chip Square -CL
detail: An 8-bit square lead with game-console crunch: fast runs, arpeggio-style melodies, chiptune hooks. X: Duty; Y: Crunch.

name: Vowel Talker -CL
detail: A talking lead: every note says "wow" through a vocal wavetable, and the mod wheel changes the vowel. Talk-box funk lines, robot hooks. X: Vowel; Y: Sweep.

name: Polyester Pad -CL
detail: The 80s polysynth pad: pulse-width shimmer and a warm saw underneath. Sustained chords that move by themselves; the preset Chorus is the famous stereo wash. X: Warmth; Y: PWM.

name: Breath Choir -CL
detail: An airy choir of vocal wavetables: ooh drifting toward aah, breath in the tone. Hold wide chords under a ballad or a hymn. X: Vowel; Y: Air.

name: Dark Matter -CL
detail: A slow, dark, living drone: two atmospheric wavetables drifting at different speeds under a closed filter. Cinematic intros, tension beds, ambient sets. X: Depth; Y: Attack.

name: Glass Halo -CL
detail: A bell-pad halo: every chord strikes like glass, then melts into a soft shimmering pad with an octave floating above. Christmas ballads, intros, worship. X: Brightness; Y: Shimmer.

name: CS Sunrise -CL
detail: The Blade Runner brass pad: detuned saws whose filter rises slowly like a sunrise, with a late, gentle vibrato. Channel pressure opens it further. Hold long chords. X: Sunrise; Y: Warmth.

name: Soft Cloud -CL
detail: A light, airy pad that stays out of the way: high, soft and wide, with almost no low end, made to sit under a piano or a vocal (a Dual Patch partner). X: Air; Y: Brightness.

name: Supersaw Anthem -CL
detail: Trance and big-room supersaw: a wall of detuned saws for anthem chords and stabs. Short release keeps it tight; widen it with Y. X: Tone; Y: Width.

name: Lagoon Pluck -CL
detail: Tropical-house pluck: a soft, round snap that sits perfectly in offbeat chord patterns. The preset Delay (dotted eighths) makes it bounce. X: Pluck; Y: Length.

name: Funk Poly -CL
detail: A snappy analog poly for funk comping: saw and pulse through a quick filter envelope, velocity decides the bite. Short chords, lots of space. X: Snap; Y: Length.

name: Reso Stab 90 -CL
detail: A resonant early-90s house stab: a squelchy filter blip on every chord. Play rhythmic stabs; turn Y for more squelch. X: Sweep; Y: Resonance.

name: Vibes Night Club -CL
detail: Vibraphone with the motor on: soft mallets, a metallic bar partial and a slow amplitude shimmer. Jazz ballads, lounge chords; use the sustain pedal like the real damper bar. X: Motor; Y: Decay.

name: Glock Candy -CL
detail: Glockenspiel built from its real bar partials (1, 2.76, 5.4, 8.9): a bright, pure ding that rings two octaves up. Melodies over pads, Christmas, music-box lines. X: Decay; Y: Brightness.

name: Kalimba Sun -CL
detail: Thumb piano: a round, woody pluck with the kalimba's high overtone ringing briefly on top. Afro-pop riffs, lullabies, bright arpeggios. X: Pluck; Y: Decay.

name: Pan Flute Andes -CL
detail: Pan flute with breath and chiff: a pure tone wrapped in air, vibrato that comes in late. Andean melodies, film themes, meditation. X: Breath; Y: Vibrato.

name: Clarinet Shadow -CL
detail: A clarinet voice: hollow odd harmonics, a woody tone that brightens as you play higher and harder, legato slurs. Klezmer, jazz, chamber lines. X: Reed; Y: Breath.

name: Clean Chime -CL
detail: A clean electric guitar pluck with a bright pick and a warm body: arpeggios, chord melodies, indie riffs. The preset Chorus and Delay make it a 90s clean tone. X: Pick; Y: Decay.

name: Banjo Porch -CL
detail: Bright, twangy banjo: thin steel strings and a drum-head resonance, short and punchy. Bluegrass rolls, country fills. X: Twang; Y: Decay.

name: Finger Round -CL
detail: A round finger-style electric bass: warm thump, soft top, natural decay. Walks, grooves, ballads. Velocity adds the finger attack. X: Tone; Y: Pluck.

name: Mono Floor -CL
detail: The classic mono synth bass: saw and square over a sub, a filter punch on every note, legato slides. Funk, disco, synth-pop. X: Cutoff; Y: Punch.

name: Koto Garden -CL
detail: Koto: a plucked silk-string tone with a tiny pitch drop at the attack and a woody decay. Pentatonic melodies, tremolo picking, film scenes. X: Pluck; Y: Decay.

name: Heartbeat Pulse -CL
detail: A tempo-synced pulsing pad: sixteenth-note gates breathe through the chord, locked to the tempo (118 BPM here, or incoming MIDI clock). Hold one chord and let it drive the song. X: Gate; Y: Tone.

name: Riser Nebula -CL
detail: An eight-second riser: a noisy supersaw cloud that climbs an octave while its filter opens, through shimmer, echoes and a huge plate. Hold one note into the drop. X: Noise; Y: Width.
